sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied don-manuel-i-abella-central-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site, not an asserted capture URL. Affine independent check errors: 0.82 m, 3.44 m. Meets 5 m check limit. Central red roof, western classroom row and fan-shaped south courtyard. Dense crowns obscure much of the yard. The upper west classroom corner is obscured by canopy, so the independent check uses the visible south-front classroom corner instead. Imagery-to-OSM disagreements are clipped to complete mapped obstacles; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date or exact inventory inferred. No bitmap ships.
